verdict.rationale: Tavily ships an official Python SDK (`pip install tavily-python`, with a quick-start and reference docs covering search, extract, crawl, map, research, project and session attribution, and keyless mode) and an official JavaScript/TypeScript SDK with its own quick-start and reference docs. The Python SDK's GitHub repo sits under the tavily-ai org. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the SDKs in use, and evidence that the JS SDK covers crawl/map/research (its docs mention only search and extract).
